content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Savannah

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review the specific hour thresholds based on your degree level. Granite PM Academy's advisors can walk you through the checklist before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Attend all sessions synchronously from Savannah or anywhere with internet access. Earn your required formal-education hours and receive your Certificate of Completion, which you'll need for your PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and formally apply for PMP eligibility. Submit your education verification and project-experience documentation. Pay PMI's exam fee and await application approval before scheduling your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence. Schedule your computer-based PMP exam with Pearson VUE at a testing center in Savannah or online. Complete the four-hour, 180-question assessment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the standard three-year renewal cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, professional activities, and volunteering. Renew your credential with PMI before expiration to remain certified.
